entities.name: Callapheia
entities.description: Epic story from Theros recounting the adventures of Callaphe the Mariner after the Akroan War.

entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: Human trickster from Meletis who sailed The Monsoon and was first mortal to decipher the winds' patterns.

entities.name: Mount Velus
entities.description: Mountain Callaphe sneaks into to steal Purphoros's tears.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God whose secrets Callaphe writes down.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God Callaphe races over the edge of the world.

entities.name: Ketaphos
entities.description: Island that exists in Nyx at night and the mortal realm by day.

entities.name: Akroan War
entities.description: War after which Callaphe's adventures take place.

events.summary: Callaphe steals Purphoros's tears, writes down Phenax's secrets, races Thassa and sails into Nyx to become a star.
events.quote: Callaphe sneaks into Mount Velus to steal Purphoros 's tears

events.summary: A storm drives The Monsoon to Ketaphos where Nyxborn centaurs feed the crew, who are then stranded on a barren rock at dawn.
events.quote: Callaphe and the crew are welcomed and fed by a band of Nyxborn centaurs

relations.quote: sailed a ship called The Monsoon
